title: OneDrive: build and share agents from OneDrive files, with .agent files retiring after March 2027
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly extends the Copilot Chat-only blocking limitation to all agents, including the new Agent Builder experience. Microsoft documents broader blocking for Agent Builder agents. The retirement dates, licence requirement and listed control routes are supported, with smaller qualifications needed for automation and government availability.
